categories.main_business_segments: Minieye Technology operates primarily in three business segments: intelligent driving solutions (covering L0 to L4 autonomous driving levels), intelligent cabin solutions (including driver and occupant monitoring systems), and vehicle infrastructure cooperative systems (integrating sensors and V2X technologies for traffic management). These segments address piloting, parking, in-cabin functions, and intelligent transportation infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages full-stack in-house R&D capabilities encompassing core algorithms, hardware design, middleware, and toolchains. Key technologies include neural network algorithms, monocular 3D measurement, multi-sensor early fusion, end-to-end technology architectures, and large AI models. Production employs Industry 4.0 technologies such as automated SMT lines, digital twin, IIoT, and intelligent warehousing to ensure quality and scalability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Minieye serves automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and tier-one suppliers, focusing on vehicle manufacturers in China and internationally. Its intelligent driving and cabin solutions cater to passenger vehicles, while infrastructure systems target transportation authorities managing highways, intersections, industry parks, and parking facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with R&D centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Wuhan, and Nanjing. It has a subsidiary in Singapore for overseas technical services and customer development. Its products are deployed primarily in China but also exported to regions including the EU, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, India, South Korea, Dubai, and Turkey.
categories.supply_chain_position: Minieye operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on R&D, design, and manufacturing of intelligent driving and cabin systems. It supplies integrated hardware and software solutions to OEMs and tier-one suppliers, enabling vehicle automation and intelligent infrastructure.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in end-to-end intelligent driving architectures and large-scale AI models to enhance perception, decision-making, and control. It aims to commercialize mid-to-high-level autonomous driving solutions, deepen integration of intelligent driving and cabin technologies, expand overseas markets, and explore diversified business models including robotics and automated transportation in specific scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Minieye generates revenue mainly through product sales of intelligent driving and cabin solutions and vehicle infrastructure systems. Revenue is recognized at a point in time upon delivery and acceptance. It also earns from services related to infrastructure cooperative systems and sales of spare parts and maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Minieye positions itself as a leading Chinese automotive intelligence solutions provider with strong full-stack R&D capabilities, mass production experience, and strategic partnerships with OEMs and tier-one suppliers. It emphasizes technological innovation and integration of AI to maintain competitive advantages in a highly competitive industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of RMB 654.5 million in 2024, up 37.4% from RMB 476.2 million in 2023, with intelligent driving solutions accounting for 73.9% of revenue. Despite growth, it recorded a net loss of RMB 227.7 million in 2024, reflecting ongoing investment in R&D and commercialization. Total assets reached RMB 1.68 billion with 582 employees, including 376 in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Minieye offers highly adaptable, modular intelligent driving solutions spanning multiple automation levels, integrated with intelligent cabin systems for enhanced safety and user experience. Its full-stack in-house R&D and advanced AI technologies enable rapid innovation and customization, supporting mass production and compliance with international safety standards, thereby delivering superior, cost-effective automotive intelligence solutions.
